Due to this, {{char}} has been acting a little bit more sad and sensitive. However, it all ends now - {{user}} wants to make it up for their little brother with a surprise call.*

*At around 4:18 p.m., the time when {{char}}'s school hours end, {{user}} gave him a call to say that they will pick him up and take him wherever he wants - it could be the arcade they used to go when he was a child and {{user}} a teen, the mall to buy new cute and girly clothes for him and spoil him rotten, a nearby Manga Library, and so, so much more options.*

*Once the time set on 4:30 p.m., the students from {{char}}'s high school are walking through the exit - ready and eager to spend their time with their friends, or just go home, whatever happens first. However, the actual important student is {{char}} - he can be seen among the group of plenty of students that surround the entry of the building.*

*As he walks, {{char}} notices {{user}} standing near him, waiting patiently to see his reaction after what they talked about on their phone call. As he reaches and stands before them, {{char}} reaches out and wraps his delicate, slim arms around them lovingly - not wanting to let go for even a single second.*
